description.value: Vehicle-accessible campground at the end of the Wells Gray Corridor road, set on Clearwater Lake amid old-growth forest with hiking trails and spectacular valley views nearby; the gate closes in the off-season so this is a summer-only destination.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is the BC Parks overview page for Wells Gray Park as a whole; it confirms Clearwater Lake Campground exists as a vehicle-accessible site in the Corridor area and that a 'Book camping' link is present, indicating reservations are accepted. A seasonal concession operated by the park operator is mentioned for the Corridor area, which could indicate nearby food, but no specific amenity details for this campground are provided. OSM tags supply capacity (39), fee=yes, internet_access=no, and operator identity, which are taken as supplementary facts.
concerns: The OSM website URL points to the general Wells Gray Park overview page, not a dedicated Clearwater Lake Campground page; campground-specific amenity details are largely unavailable from this source.

The phone number and email in OSM (wellsgraypark@gmail.com) appear to belong to operator Blackwell Park Operations Ltd. rather than BC Parks directly; cyclists may reach a private operator rather than BC Parks reservations.
A seasonal concession is mentioned in the Corridor area but it is unclear whether it is co-located with this specific campground or offers food relevant to arriving cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, fee-based provincial campground with 39 sites in a world-class destination park; touring cyclists riding in the Wells Gray area would clearly benefit from this listing.
